title: SchemaCatalog
description: Declarative schema catalog wire form (source of truth: schemas/schema-catalog.json). The catalog has its own catalogFormatVersion (not an entry SchemaVersion). Entries carry schemaId, schemaVersion, documentId, a repo-relative path, and a status {Draft, Stable, Deprecated}. Optional 'rules' declare explicit directional compatibility/migration edges (readable = additive non-breaking, migration = requires conversion); compatibility is never inferred from semver. DRAFT / NON-FROZEN. Two-level validation: this schema enforces the syntactic shape; duplicate-tuple/path/documentId, path traversal/absolute paths, on-disk $id/version matching, and local $ref resolution are enforced by the core (validate_catalog / validate_catalog_files).

$schema.description: The catalog INSTANCE binds to the catalog schema document via this $schema value. The instance must NOT carry its own $id (additionalProperties: false rejects it).

path.description: Repo-relative path (forward slashes, source tree only). The core additionally rejects absolute paths and '..' traversal.
